outcome.determination: THIS CYCLE ESTABLISHES NOTHING ABOUT THE MARKET. Under B1 only a successful source response can establish NO_QUALIFYING_MARKET, and zero sources responded. Six ACCESS_BLOCKED results are a statement about our access, not about whether 7/27 pitcher-K markets exist.

structural_blockers.detail: All 6 book sources AND statsapi.mlb.com returned HTTP 403. statsapi is a plain public JSON API that does not bot-block, so a uniform 403 across seven unrelated hosts indicates the environment's network policy is refusing non-allowlisted outbound requests - our perimeter, not seven independent refusals. Retrying later will not change this.
structural_blockers.consequence: The agent cannot reach any market source from this environment.

structural_blockers.detail: WebFetch 'converts the page to markdown and answers the prompt using a small fast model'. It returns model-summarised prose, never the original HTML/JSON. A5 requires the original response or a timestamped screenshot, hashed.
structural_blockers.consequence: Even with egress, an agent-side WebFetch capture could satisfy neither A5 (no raw artifact to hash) nor B1's 'successful source response' standard for NO_QUALIFYING_MARKET - it would be a summariser's report of a source, which is the documented 'summaries are not sources' failure class.

cycle_defects.detail: Individual observed_at_utc was not recorded per source; only the cycle window 03:43:02Z-03:44:20Z was captured. A4 requires a per-capture timestamp.
cycle_defects.impact: None to any quote - every source was ACCESS_BLOCKED and no quote was at stake. Logged so the next cycle stamps each call.
